request: Continuous wastewater-pipe cutaway below first-level floor. Flow and floating inappropriate debris diminish toward Clogfather; grease and lodged debris increase to total blockage. Environmental storytelling only.

placement.coordinate_rule: Logical world y, same horizontal transform as floor (world_x minus camera_x). Pipe is physical scene infrastructure, not a screen-fixed overlay or distant parallax layer. Retain floor silhouette and landing-edge contrast.
placement.art: Request original modular pipe shell, interior, flowing water, debris and terminal grease plug from Bestiary / Art through Engineering dimensions. Clip all contents to bore; never substitute code-drawn production art. No floor openings or damage collider implied.

parameter_meaning: Water fraction measures56px bore height from bottom; coverage is projected visible blockage, not entity count or a hydraulic simulation. Values are visual targets. Preserve the user-requested falling level even if real obstruction hydrology would differ.
interpolation: Treat section values as targets at their midpoints. Interpolate smoothly along WORLD x, then ease to exact zero flow/zero water/full plug at x14150. Every visible pipe segment samples its own world coordinate, so camera spanning a boundary shows a continuous gradient rather than changing the entire screen at once. No dependence on kills, clock elapsed or gates.

debris.floating: Early sections: sparse individual wipes, cotton swabs, toothbrushes, hair clumps and one occasional absurd non-branded item. Art decides exact motifs.8–20 logical pixels, occasional24px item;4–6 moving pieces visible,hard cap8. No collectible glow or hostile-bullet silhouette.
debris.direction: Flow consistently right toward the obstruction. Early debris follows water at modest varied speed. As flow drops, floaters decrease; static lodged material takes over. Never reverse with player movement.
debris.accumulation: Midroute: caught wipes and hair around pipe seams, increasingly greasy deposits. Final approach: tiny stagnant puddles between debris, motion slows nearly to rest. Arena: continuous opaque grease/oil/debris mass fills bore; no water-scroll animation or moving floaters.
debris.determinism: Seed variation by stable world-segment ID and session seed. Reuse pooled pieces; no new random reshuffle when camera moves back. Wrap/drift offscreen or behind physical seam, not visible teleportation.
debris.animation_clock: Pause with gameplay during pause/dialogue/dispenser; do not advance catch-up bursts on resume.

readability: Everything stays below y456; no debris, splash or foreground pipe rim obscures feet, platforms, landing cues or enemies.
Water/debris contrast and saturation stay below hostile-projectile emphasis; avoid rapid glints,screen shake or foreground occlusion.
Allow thin pipe joints but retain at least80percent visible bore across an ordinary screen; no long opaque floor band hiding the storytelling.
Draw after base background and before floor lip/foreground edge; remove or mask existing opaque below-floor fill so it does not cover new cutaway. HUD and dialogue stay above environmental rendering.
At alternate display sizes use normal canvas scaling; no new camera zoom or reduced gameplay height.
backtracking: Position-defined story: returning toward entrance shows that location wetter and less clogged again, while debris drift uses persistent phase. Never use furthest-player-progress to dry the whole pipe. Respawn returns to local appearance; restart resets animation seed/time according to existing session policy without changing spatial profile.

boss_transition.approach: Checkpoint x13800 lies in the nearly dry approach; full blockage begins at the actual Clogfather arena x14150.
boss_transition.arena: Show one Clogfather only. Terminal plug is inert grease/debris, not a second face/body/silhouette. Align pipe termination under the planned boss/outflow; no implication hero can enter it.
boss_transition.activation: Do not wait for boss trigger to switch wet pipe to dry; obstruction is already spatially established. Boss HUD/intro do not alter pipe state.
boss_transition.defeat: Default keep blocked appearance until an explicit restoration animation/story beat is approved. Boss death does not silently imply all plumbing repaired or portal revealed. If restoration is later approved, author a separate state transition with Storyboarding.
boss_transition.retry: Return to pre-fight blocked appearance if boss resets. No invisible environmental hazards, enemy spawns or damage tied to debris.

trial_integration.profile: For trial only, sample story_x=min(actual_trial_x,1440), holding entrance/stores transition thereafter. Use the same production art module; show entrance flow/debris with only mild reduction.
trial_integration.full_route: Use actual9600px world profile when integrating full mission. If route changes, remap named section anchors explicitly instead of silently scaling the boss plug to any test width.
